metadata.project: SENDA — Safe Paths to Martian Science
metadata.site: Mount Sharp Boxwork Unit, Gale Crater, Mars
sources: USGS Astrogeology MSL Gale Merged DEM 1m v3 & HiRISE Ortho 25 cm/px
MSL APXS, ChemCam LIBS & CheMin XRD PDS Geochemical Bundles

properties.name: Rustic Canyon crater
properties.type_es: Cráter de impacto / Punto de partida EVA y Antena Relay
properties.type_en: Impact crater / EVA Staging Base & S-Band Relay Mast
properties.desc_es: Cráter de impacto degradado en la transición inferior hacia la unidad boxwork. Expone estratos subsuperficiales de sulfatos y sirve como punto de referencia topográfico, base de inicio/retorno y mástil de comunicaciones de 4.5 m.
properties.desc_en: Degraded impact crater at the lower transition into the Mount Sharp boxwork unit. Exposes subsurface sulfate-bearing strata and serves as the primary topographic landmark, EVA staging/return base, and 4.5 m S-band comms relay mast.
properties.mineralogy_chemin: Basaltic regolith + polyhydrated Mg-sulfates (starkeyite) + amorphous silica

eva_sampling.protocol: Baseline instrument calibration & surface regolith blank at lander perimeter.

properties.coord_source: NASA MMGIS MSL_waypoints.json & HiRISE Ortho 25 cm/px

properties.name: Altadena (drill)
properties.desc_es: Sitio de perforación real de Curiosity en el ascenso hacia el boxwork. Permite comparar la mineralogía base del lecho rocoso rico en sulfatos antes de entrar en la red de crestas diagenéticas.
properties.desc_en: Curiosity drill site along the ascent toward the boxwork unit. Provides baseline mineralogy of the sulfate-bearing bedrock prior to entering the diagenetic ridge network.

eva_sampling.protocol: Extract 8 cm intact stratigraphy core from unaltered sulfate bedrock.

properties.name: Volcán Peña Blanca
properties.desc_es: Afloramiento prominente con laminación cruzada y vetas resistentes que anticipan el régimen de circulación de fluidos subterráneos responsable del boxwork.
properties.desc_en: Prominent cross-bedded outcrop featuring resistant mineral veins that record early stages of the subsurface fluid circulation responsible for the boxwork ridges.
properties.mineralogy_chemin: Cross-bedded sandstone cemented by anhydrite & iron-oxide concretions

eva_sampling.protocol: Sample vein-wall rock contact oriented block for paleomagnetic & fluid-inclusion analysis.

properties.name: Ridge-hollow nodular transition
properties.desc_es: Frente de alteración donde aumenta drásticamente la densidad de nódulos y concreciones minerales al aproximarse a las paredes de las crestas del boxwork.
properties.desc_en: Alteration front showing a sharp gradient in nodule and concretion density approaching the boxwork ridge walls, key to mapping fluid flow pathways.
properties.mineralogy_chemin: Fe/Mg-rich diagenetic nodules + jarosite + goethite cement

eva_sampling.protocol: Collect 3-point transect across nodule concentration gradient (0 m, 2 m, 5 m from ridge).

properties.name: Valle de la Luna (drill, Monte Grande hollow)
properties.type_es: Perforación en hondonada (interior erosionado del boxwork)
properties.type_en: Drill site in hollow (eroded boxwork interior)
properties.desc_es: Par comparativo clave #1 (a solo 10 m de T06): perforación en el piso de la depresión (hollow) de Monte Grande. Muestra la roca matriz menos cementada que no resistió la erosión eólica.
properties.desc_en: Key paired sample #1 (located just 10 m from T06): drill target in the floor of the Monte Grande hollow. Captures the less-cemented host rock matrix that failed to resist eolian erosion.
properties.mineralogy_chemin: Uncemented phyllosilicate-bearing mudstone/sandstone + soluble Mg-sulfates (low CaSO4 vein fraction)

eva_sampling.tool: Deep Rotary Core Drill + Organic-Clean Sealed Tube
eva_sampling.protocol: Paired Core A (Hollow Floor): preserve volatile sulfates & clay interlayer water for Earth return.

properties.name: Nevado Sajama (drill, ridge)
properties.type_es: Perforación en cresta (pared mineralizada del boxwork)
properties.type_en: Drill site on ridge crest (cemented boxwork wall)
properties.desc_es: Par comparativo clave #2 (a 10 m de T05): perforación en el tope de la cresta cementada. Responde la pregunta central de SENDA: qué fluidos precipitaron minerales endurecedores que preservaron las crestas y si albergaron microambientes habitables tardíos.
properties.desc_en: Key paired sample #2 (10 m from T05): drill site on the cemented boxwork ridge crest. Directly addresses SENDA's core science question: why ridges resist erosion while hollows do not, and whether late-stage groundwater fluids supported habitable micro-environments.
properties.mineralogy_chemin: Dense Ca-sulfate (bassanite/anhydrite) + silica/hematite fracture-halo cement locking boxwork ridge

eva_sampling.tool: High-Torque Diamond Core Drill + Biosignature Cryo-Tube
eva_sampling.protocol: Paired Core B (Ridge Crest): sample central fracture vein + cemented halo for fluid-inclusion biosignatures.

properties.name: Monte Grande polygons
properties.type_es: Red de fracturas poligonales y vetas de sulfato de calcio
properties.type_en: Polygonal fracture network & calcium sulfate veins
properties.desc_es: Patrón geométrico de fracturas por desecación o contracción rellenas de minerales blancos. Un astronauta puede realizar muestreo selectivo milimétrico entre la veta central y el halo de alteración sin contaminar la muestra.
properties.desc_en: Geometric desiccation/contraction fracture network filled with light-toned mineral veins. Requires human dexterity for millimeter-scale selective sampling across the central vein and its alteration halo.

eva_sampling.protocol: Millimeter-scale selective extraction of white vein core vs. dark Fe-rich alteration rind.

properties.name: Eastern boxwork contact
properties.type_es: Contacto estratigráfico oriental y pared de blindaje natural
properties.type_en: Eastern boxwork stratigraphic contact & natural radiation shelter
properties.desc_es: Contacto lateral oriental donde las crestas del boxwork alcanzan mayor relieve local (~3–5 m de pared vertical), ofreciendo simultáneamente exposición transversal de las vetas profundas y el mayor factor de blindaje topográfico ante un evento de partículas solares (SPE).
properties.desc_en: Eastern lateral contact where boxwork ridges reach maximum local relief (~3–5 m steep escarpment), providing both a cross-sectional exposure of deep fracture plumbing and the highest topographic sky-blocking shielding (38% dose reduction) during a Solar Particle Event (SPE).
properties.mineralogy_chemin: Silica-indurated boxwork wall contact + ferric sulfate cement

eva_sampling.protocol: Vertical stratigraphic profile along 4 m escarpment + verify SPE alcove shielding geometry.
